workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: api: preserve OAuth access after SSO closure

head_commit.message:
api: preserve OAuth access after SSO closure

Closing an SSO removes its token while retaining authorization links.
A valid renewable OAuth session may outlive that token, including after
expiry cleanup and refresh. Its next resume dereferences the missing token.

Only extend the associated SSO token when it exists and expires before
the renewed access token. Keep a closed SSO token absent and preserve
the expiry policy for present tokens.

Cover persisted closure and cleanup/refresh/resume paths, along with
expiry preservation, missing links and existing access denial behavior.

workflow_runs.display_title: tests: verify remote restore payloads across persistent queue settings

head_commit.message:
tests: verify remote restore payloads across persistent queue settings

Persist zero transfer delays in the remote-restore scenario and prove they
survive a graceful daemon restart before its transaction chains start.
Keep production queue defaults unchanged and remove transient repatching.

Verify distinct payloads in two remote backup snapshots, their absence
after reinstall, restoration of the second payload and a later incremental
backup with a third payload. Bind the incremental base to transaction
evidence, destination receive history, snapshot GUIDs and branch topology.

Record bounded chain, queue, daemon and error projections on failure without
replacing the original error or dumping configuration and signed requests.

confirmations for direct API calls as well as nested transaction chains.

Add the default-false keep_empty_group_snapshots option for separately
provisioned shared templates. Keep their action and task on last removal,
validate repeat enrollment and preserve legacy first-open backup selection.
Expose confirmation chain identity through a read-only accessor.

Normalize validated numeric schedule fields to their persisted strings so
enrollment, shared-task reuse and removal compare the same schedule.

Deploy scheduler and Plan support before enabling retained-template plans.
Retire their memberships and schedules before returning to older Plan code.

workflow_runs.display_title: Use the shared transient node exchange for inventory

head_commit.message:
Use the shared transient node exchange for inventory

The normal NodeCtld and Supervisor publishers declare each node exchange as
transient. The inventory receiver and sender instead requested a durable
exchange, so RabbitMQ refused the signed 5290 transport before dispatch.
Declare the existing exchange in both inventory endpoints with the same
properties as the other node traffic. Keep the durable bounded reply queue.

history date filters when resolving anchors through included properties.

anchors and terminal pages using actual API resource specs.

workflow_runs.display_title: webui: manage IP release campaigns and user retention

head_commit.message:
webui: manage IP release campaigns and user retention

Let administrators filter unused owned IPs, preview a fixed selection,
edit campaign policy, send notices and reminders, manage bulk exemptions
and release eligible addresses manually. Use the usual table headers and
separate sidebar navigation from currently available campaign actions.
Warn about an early date without blocking release; explain closure.

Use multi-select filters and 500-address pages. Preserve selection and
settings across preview pages in the authenticated session, with an
explicit all-matches action. Show translated campaign IDs without custom
labels and record who supplied each reason or exemption.

Let members follow the email button through login, view their release
date and own addresses, assign them to a VPS or keep them with a reason.
Keep release diagnostics and campaign management in the admin interface.
Include Czech translations and browser coverage of the full workflow.

workflow_runs.display_title: api: retain valid evidence across rejected node reports

head_commit.message:
api: retain valid evidence across rejected node reports

Preserve the latest comparable report and its original observation time in
an internal checkpoint before invalid evidence replaces the current snapshot.
Use the checkpoint after supervisor restart, prefer newer retained events
when older writers leave it stale, and clear it with successful recovery.
Keep rejected current evidence visible without publishing extra snapshots.

Do not let an older application fallback replace a newer proven kernel
confirmation. Keep checkpoint writes inside the node lock and transaction,
and preserve event timestamps, revisions and immutable evidence.

Add an empty checkpoint table without backfill and cover recovery across
software, deployment, sysctl, module, eBPF and livepatch histories, including
the synthetic supervisor restart integration scenario.

workflow_runs.display_title: api: fix anonymous DDNS account-state checks

head_commit.message:
api: fix anonymous DDNS account-state checks

DDNS authenticates with a record token and has no current API user. Make
only the administrator exception nil-safe so user-owned zones can update
while non-active owners remain blocked.

Cover anonymous A and AAAA updates, unchanged addresses, non-active
owners, and authenticated owner and administrator behavior with request
specs.
